title: Teleconnections between Antarctic Sea Ice and ISMR
content: Antarctic sea-ice variability demonstrates significant teleconnections with the Indian Summer Monsoon Rainfall (ISMR). Anomalous sea-ice retreat in the Bellingshausen-Amundsen Seas correlates with heightened ISMR.

title: Southern Ocean Sea Ice Extent (2010-2023)
content: Dataset containing daily observations of sea ice extent in the Southern Ocean, derived from satellite microwave radiometer data.

title: Indian Antarctic Expedition 41
content: The 41st ISEA successfully extracted ice cores from the central Dronning Maud Land. Observations highlighted abnormal surface melting events in January 2022.

title: Glacial Retreat in the Himalayas
content: Observation of the Third Pole (Himalayas) shows an accelerated glacial retreat of 15% over the last decade. This affects the downstream hydrology of major Indian rivers.
